gist.headline: The garden ledger grows
gist.blurb: The hive’s daily notebook got another careful pass. App request and repository numbers are freshly gathered, so the garden can keep track of its own growth.

gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden operations desk represents the daily metrics refresh: Polli, wearing a tiny librarian visor, updates a large ledger beside a retro terminal showing simple rising app and repository charts. Small code-plants and labeled seed packets make the internal ecosystem data feel like a living garden.
